version.changelog: Simplify the login instructions to the code flow (maton login prints a link; finish with maton login --code <CODE>), drop the API Key subsection, and pin the Maton CLI install to 0.4.0.

llm.summary: This YouTube skill is a clearly documented Maton API integration with disclosed OAuth, write-operation, and automation risks guarded by user-approval instructions.

dimensions.detail: The skill needs network access, a Maton account, and OAuth credentials stored by the OS credential manager; this is proportionate for a managed YouTube API gateway and the artifact warns not to inspect or expose credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses pinned Maton CLI/package versions via npm or Homebrew and contains markdown documentation only, with no bundled executable code or hidden install script.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions default to read/list calls, require explicit approval for connection creation and all writes, warn against acting on untrusted API content, and limit non-YouTube trigger references to user-requested platform event catalogues.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: OAuth sessions, hosted functions, triggers, and destinations can persist, but the artifact repeatedly discloses that persistence and requires separate user approval, narrow scope, and cleanup for high-impact automation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill can search/read YouTube data and perform user-directed writes such as playlist, subscription, rating, and comment changes; those capabilities fit the stated YouTube integration purpose and are documented.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this skill can act on your connected YouTube account and can create persistent Maton automations if you approve them. Use the read/list flows first, confirm the exact account and resource before writes, and avoid raw API-key mode unless the CLI cannot be used.
llm.findings: [SQP-3] expected: The hard-coded "en" value appears in an illustrative YouTube playlist creation example, while nearby text says to set the language to the playlist content or user's locale and ask when unclear; this is a minor documentation quality issue, not evidence of hidden or purpose-mismatched behavior.
